anti_tuning_rule: After first validation output is opened, do not change production candidate, questions, source artifact, gold spans, or reader arm definitions in this cycle.

decision_rule.structural: No new source/version/snapshot/negation regressions; compare gains/losses on 24 answerable plus fail-closed behavior on 16 controls.
decision_rule.presentation: Only a preselected P3 arm may be tested; rollout requires >=5 percentage-point grounded-correct gain, project-cluster bootstrap lower bound > 0, no increase in unsupported answers, and transparent cost/latency.
